# glinet_parental_control_apps (Data Source)

Get the apps of the app feature library of parental control (`parental-control.get_app_list`). Use the IDs in `apps` of `glinet_parental_control_ruleset`. The router can return the list also when it does not use the app feature library (`app_filter_enabled` of `glinet_parental_control`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_parental_control_apps" "all" {}

# The IDs of the game apps (type 2).
output "game_app_ids" {
  value = [for app in data.glinet_parental_control_apps.all.apps : app.id if app.type == 2]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) Apps of the app feature library. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) ID of the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the app.
- `type` (Number) Type of the app: 1 social, 2 game, 3 video, 4 shopping, 5 music, 6 recruitment, 7 download, 8 portal.
